12 April, 2024
Author: Shekhar Kumar Yadav

Bench: Shekhar Kumar Yadav
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Jitendra Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.
1.
Heard Mr. Jitendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicants and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.

2. This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case No.2375 of 1999 arising out Case Crime No.225 of 1999, under Sections 498A, 304 B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Muhammdabad, District Mau.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the present case, in fact, no such incident has taken place.

The applicants have never committed any Smt. Luhiya Devi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17073393/
1 offence as alleged in the impugned FIR.

entities.text: Smt. Luhiya Devi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Impugned FIR has been lodged as many as against eight accused persons including the applicants.
The applicant no.1 is mother-in-law (saas), the applicant no.2 is Jethani and applicant no.3 is Devrani.
Against the impugned order, applicants have filed Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.4502 of 1999 and this Court vide order dated 24.09.1999 granted stay order in favour of the applicants.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.4502 of 1999
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
During trial, all the witnesses have turned hostile, therefore,
all the co-accused persons except the applicants have been exonerated.
He further submits that PWs 1 to 4 have not levelled any allegations against the applicants but the court below in a routine manner issued NBW against the applicants.
The applicants are old house wives ladies having no previous criminal history.

4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicants and has submitted that perusal of record clearly shows that the court below has issued NBW against the applicants on 12.10.2022 and the same is still in operation.
Since the applicants are continuously not appearing before the court below and avoiding from the proceedings initiated against them, the court below has rightly issued NBW against the applicants.

5. After having heard the learned counsel for the parties present and perused the order sheet of the court below as well as material brought on record and also keeping in view the fact that the applicants are continuously absconding from the proceedings, there is no justification for granting anticipatory bail to the applicants.
Accordingly, the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail is hereby refused.

6. However, considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as submissions advanced by learned counsel for the applicant, the court below is directed to conclude the trial of the aforesaid case, in accordance with law, within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this Court without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties.
7. With the aforesaid observation, the present anticipatory bail application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 12.4.2024 Ajeet  Smt. Luhiya Devi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17073393/
